exposure: International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) codes for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
PAS referral centers vs. nonreferral obstetric hospitals
outcome: composite maternal morbidity (blood loss ≥ 1,500 mL, length of stay > 4 days, reoperation, shock, coagulopathy, genitourinary injury, thromboembolism, or mortality)
cohort: Deliveries with ICD-10 codes for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) in 17 hospitals across two large health care systems in one Mountain West state between September 2015 and December 2023.
finding: ICD-10 codes for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) were frequently misapplied, particularly at nonreferral centers, and although referral centers managed more severe true PAS cases, maternal morbidity was not significantly different between center types after adjustment.
